mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) which was established by the Central Bank of Nigeria (Establishment) Act 2007."
Lead Bank regulator The lead bank regulatory is the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) which was established by the Central Bank of Nigeria (Establishment) Act 2007.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for protecting the organization's intellectual property and ensure strict confidentiality."
Employees or agents are responsible for protecting the organization's intellectual property and ensure strict confidentiality.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special, non-bank financial institution intervenes in mobilizing funds for investments in securities in response to the liquidity of the system."
A discount house is a special, non-bank financial institution intervenes in mobilizing funds for investments in securities in response to the liquidity of the system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a self-sustaining financial institution owned and managed within a community to provide financial services to that community."
A community bank in Nigeria is a self-sustaining financial institution owned and managed within a community to provide financial services to that community.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of principles designed to guide behaviour."
Code of ethics is a set of principles designed to guide behaviour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of the money and capital markets."
The financial sector is made up of the money and capital markets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of official instructions or statement of purpose."
A mandate is a set of official instructions or statement of purpose.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the purely private ownership of the scheme."
An alternative arrangement is the purely private ownership of the scheme.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any individual or group of people who could lose or gain something because of the actions of the organization."
A Stakeholder is any individual or group of people who could lose or gain something because of the actions of the organization.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the incentive for excessive risk taking by banks or those receiving the benefit of protection."
Moral hazard refers to the incentive for excessive risk taking by banks or those receiving the benefit of protection.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very vital aspect of banking operations which must be closely monitored because of its importance not only for the stability of the banking system but also that of the entire economy."
Liquidity is a very vital aspect of banking operations which must be closely monitored because of its importance not only for the stability of the banking system but also that of the entire economy.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statutory Committee comprising of regulators in the Nigerian financial services sector (the banking sector, the capital market, the insurance sector, the pension sector)."
The FSRCC is a statutory Committee comprising of regulators in the Nigerian financial services sector (the banking sector, the capital market, the insurance sector, the pension sector).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any group which has an interest in, involvement with, dependence on, contribution to, or is affected by, the organization."
A modern definition of a Stakeholder is any group which has an interest in, involvement with, dependence on, contribution to, or is affected by, the organization.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the responsibility of three departments, namely, the Bank Examination Department (BED), the Insurance and Surveillance Department (ISD) and Special Insured Institutions Department (SIID)."

Bank Supervision in the NDIC is the responsibility of three departments, namely, the Bank Examination Department (BED), the Insurance and Surveillance Department (ISD) and Special Insured Institutions Department (SIID).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the returns that must be made by financial institutions as provided for in various acts governing the banking business."
Statutory returns are the returns that must be made by financial institutions as provided for in various acts governing the banking business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system established by the Government to protect depositors against the loss of their insured deposits (NDIC, 2017)."
Deposit Insurance is a system established by the Government to protect depositors against the loss of their insured deposits (NDIC, 2017).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a channel for mobilising long-term funds."
The Nigerian Capital Market is a channel for mobilising long-term funds.

CBN

Cash
